Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Concoction of Vitality's text:

Unique equipment.
When the vampire with this card announces an action,
he or she may burn this card to prevent vampires from blocking that action.
If he or she does so, this vampire cannot play cards requiring Disciplines
until the action is complete.

Can you play other "As action is announced" effects at the same time
as burning the Concoction? That is, can Terry the Blood Brother (who has
dom and san) Govern the Unaligned, with a Walk of Caine "as action is
announced" and still burn the Concoction to make it unblockable?

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 05 Aug 2002 11:16:13 GMT, Jozxyqk asked:

>Can you play other "As action is announced" effects at the same time

>as burning the Concoction of Vitality? That is, can Terry the Blood Brother (who has

>dom and san) Govern the Unaligned, with a Walk of Caine "as action is
>announced" and still burn the Concoction to make it unblockable?

Yes.

LSJ 2002-04-29
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3CCD6922.77D96100%40white-wolf.com

> I have a Q about the timing of cards you play "when the acton is
> announced." More specifically: if the acting Meth can decide on the
> order, can a vampire play Perfect Clarity first and then burn a
> Concoction of Vitality?

Yes. The "when announced" effects can be done in any order. The
restriction is that they are all done before any other effects (or "do
you block?" questions) are done.
